recorded.prompt:q-join-after-failure: the page and the question, and nothing else

recorded.outcome:q-join-after-failure: The loader example shows the exception printed by the uncaught-exception handler, join() returning normally, and main carrying on with an empty list, which decides c.
recorded.prompt:q-daemon-buffered-log: the page and the question, and nothing else

recorded.outcome:q-virtual-uploads-at-exit: The page says a virtual thread is always a daemon and that virtual threads started from main are dropped mid-step at exit, which decides d.

recorded.outcome:q-cpu-bound-on-virtual: The 80 computing tasks on 20 cores took 219 vs 220 ms and the page says 20 CPUs do 20 tasks' arithmetic at a time whatever kind of thread asks, which decides a by short inference to 16 CPUs and a 16-thread pool.

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-join-after-failure:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-join-after-failure:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-join-after-failure:a: Refuted by 'Nothing connects a thread's failure to the thread that started it' and 'join() returned normally'.
recorded.prompt:q-join-after-failure:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-join-after-failure:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-join-after-failure:b: Refuted: the page ties ExecutionException to FutureTask.get() and shows join() returning normally after a Runnable failed.
recorded.prompt:q-join-after-failure:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-join-after-failure:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-join-after-failure:d: Refuted: the page says the JVM hands the failure to the failing thread's handler, which prints it, and nothing connects it to the starter, so nothing is held for main.
recorded.prompt:q-daemon-buffered-log:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-daemon-buffered-log:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-daemon-buffered-log:a: Refuted by 'The exporter wasn't interrupted and got no exception.'
recorded.prompt:q-daemon-buffered-log:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-daemon-buffered-log:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-daemon-buffered-log:c: Refuted: the daemon exporter had its writer open and the JVM still shut down as main returned; only started non-daemon threads keep it waiting.
recorded.prompt:q-daemon-buffered-log:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-daemon-buffered-log:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-daemon-buffered-log:d: Refuted by 'setDaemon(true) lets the JVM abandon the thread's work between any two instructions' and the exporter being dropped mid-sleep.
recorded.prompt:q-virtual-uploads-at-exit:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-virtual-uploads-at-exit:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-virtual-uploads-at-exit:a: Refuted: inheritance of daemon status is stated for platform threads, and the page shows a virtual thread is always a daemon (isDaemon() true).
recorded.prompt:q-virtual-uploads-at-exit:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-virtual-uploads-at-exit:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-virtual-uploads-at-exit:b: Refuted by the setDaemon(false) output 'not legal for virtual threads' and isDaemon(): true.
recorded.prompt:q-virtual-uploads-at-exit:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-virtual-uploads-at-exit:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-virtual-uploads-at-exit:c: Refuted by 'at exit they are dropped mid-step, like the daemon exporter'.
recorded.prompt:q-cpu-bound-on-virtual:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cpu-bound-on-virtual:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cpu-bound-on-virtual:b: Refuted by short inference: the page ran 100,000 virtual threads on a 20-core machine, so CPUs do not cap how many virtual threads exist.
recorded.prompt:q-cpu-bound-on-virtual:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cpu-bound-on-virtual:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cpu-bound-on-virtual:c: Refuted by '20 logical CPUs do 20 tasks' arithmetic at a time, whatever kind of thread asks'.
recorded.prompt:q-cpu-bound-on-virtual:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cpu-bound-on-virtual:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cpu-bound-on-virtual:d: Refuted by the equal 219/220 ms computing timings and 'work that keeps a core busy gains nothing'.
